extension.summary: Personal TV shows and movies add-on with TorBox playback
extension.description: Browse TV shows and movies, choose a source yourself and play it through your own TorBox account. For personal use.
extension.news: 0.2.0: TV shows and movies from TMDB. Seasons, Continue Watching, My List and More like this. Plays English releases through TorBox; titles without an English release list their own-language releases and say so. 0.1.0: First NovaFlix build.
